sermon.title: Justification and Righteousness by Grace, Faith, and Jesus Alone — January 16, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus never said we are justified by grace, faith or Christ alone. The people justified God by obeying John’s message, the repentant tax collector went home justified, and by our words we are justified or condemned. The blood is the necessary ingredient.
